children: Koninklijke Philips N.V. Sponsored ADR (EURONEXT:PHIA) reported Q3 comparable sales up 3% to €4.39 billion, orders up 8% and adjusted EBITA up 7.2% to €569 million. It raised 2026 free cash flow guidance to €1.5–€1.7 billion.
: Philips reported Q3 comparable sales up 3% to €4.39 billion and orders up 8%. Adjusted EBITA rose 7.2% to €569 million. It raised 2026 free cash flow guidance to €1.5–€1.7 billion.

: PHIA’s average 12-month price target rose to $31 from $30.81 across 19 analysts, implying about 9% upside from its Nov. 3 close. Targets range from $24.72 to $43.32; 22 analysts rate it Buy or Hold.
: Philips (PHIA) said a Dutch appeals court denied investors’ requests to investigate the company’s handling of the Respironics recall.
: Koninklijke Philips (PHIA) issued €650 million in fixed-rate notes due 2034. The healthcare sector’s first EU Green Bond under the new standard was 2.7 times oversubscribed.
